verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no official NVIDIA spec sheet citation giving exact TDP/TGP wattage, connector type, or cooling requirements for the 5090, so buyers can't directly verify published board-power numbers from this pack. Community/hands-on reports directly contradict the implicit 'safe to spec around published power' claim: connector melting incidents, power spikes 'past 600W,' and Tom's Hardware docking points for the Founders Edition 'running hot' show real-world power/cooling behavior diverging from expectations.
